purpose: Prioritize peer-reviewed, high-quality agent research for full reproduction pressure. Preprints and workshop-only papers are discovery hints only and never enter the formal pressure suite.
rules: Formal pressure lanes require a peer-reviewed publication in an eligible priority class.
A later peer-reviewed version supersedes an earlier preprint identity for reproduction planning.
Preprint-only work may remain in historical reproduction storage but is removed from the active formal pressure queue.
Benchmark adapters may target external benchmark projects, but benchmark identity must be frozen to exact source/data/evaluator cuts.
Within an eligible venue class, prioritize papers that introduce distinct transferable agent semantics and fill an uncovered lineage edge.
Do not reproduce near-duplicate papers merely to increase paper count; reproduce them when they add a new mechanism, benchmark regime, or experimental claim.
